notes: Wardrobe: 10 skins (glass, gummy, pixel, chrome, galaxy, lava, rainbow, ghost, gold), 7 new colors and 5 eye styles, many unlocked by trophies. 4 new rooms: Candy land, Spooky attic, Underwater (floaty physics) and Volcano. Colorful tool icons and a free 15-second trial of any locked tool. Tricks Gloop learns from snack rewards. Building: shelves, ramps and a seesaw catapult, with your layout saved. Undo, pinned favorite tools, Gloop reacting to the tool you pick, and phone vibration.
